text.en: Dog owners consistently praise head trainer Rachael for her practical knowledge, patience, and encouraging coaching style during lessons. Clients highlight that she breaks training concepts down into straightforward, logical steps that owners can easily replicate. Reviewers frequently remark that her guidance gave them renewed confidence when handling challenging dogs.

Pet parents report remarkable behavioural transformations, with reactive, fearful, or disobedient dogs becoming calm and responsive companions. Reviewers describe significant improvements in loose-leash walking, reduction in leash reactivity around other animals, and successful preparation for obedience tests. Several owners note that early sessions produced visible changes in routine behaviour.

Clients highlight the trainer's gentle, structured approach when working with shelter rescues, young puppies, and highly reactive dogs. Reviewers appreciate that training exercises are customised to the temperament of individual dogs rather than applying a rigid system. Owners note that anxious pets developed greater focus and settled well in both home and outdoor environments.

q.en: Does Paws Down Dog Training help with leash reactivity?

a.en: Yes, clients frequently report major reductions in leash pulling and reactive barking around other animals following private coaching.

q.en: Are board-and-train programs available for puppies?

a.en: Yes, reviewers describe structured board-and-train stays in a home environment with regular progress updates and video clips.

q.en: Does the trainer provide written notes after training sessions?

a.en: Yes, clients confirm that comprehensive training summaries and follow-up guidance are shared after each coaching lesson.

q.en: Can training sessions take place in home or park settings?

a.en: Yes, lessons are conducted in household environments, local parks, or via virtual coaching depending on dog requirements.
